name: qr-code
title: QR Code
description: A share card holding a large scannable code and a URL field, with three smaller sample codes in custom colours. Editing the link regenerates the pattern and the colours follow the page theme.
use: A page, ticket or share panel needs a scannable link that updates as the address is edited.
avoid: It only encodes text into a square SVG and fails silently, so a bad input leaves an empty box with no message.
a11y: The generated SVG carries no title or label, so screen readers get no hint of what it encodes. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark bordered card on black. On the left a big square black-and-white code sits on a white rounded tile; on the right a small heading, two lines of grey copy, a wide input with the link, and a row of three small tinted codes on dark tiles.
behaves: The code is redrawn whenever the link text or a colour prop changes, so typing a new address produces a new pattern in place. The three thumbnails show the same data with violet, green and yellow foregrounds.
customise: Pass the data string and optional foreground and background oklch colours plus a robustness level. Size is not a prop; the SVG fills whatever container it is given.
weight: light: One encoder pass per data or colour change and a small injected SVG.
demo: The link https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/QR_code under the heading "Share this page".
issues: The code is an unlabelled image of the data, so screen-reader users cannot tell what it points to.
If generation throws, the component returns nothing and only logs to the console, leaving an empty frame.
polishWhy: Clean share card with crisp codes and a nice colour row; the layout and input are plain.
